 AI Front Desk: answers patient calls 24/7, including nights and weekends. It books and reschedules appointments directly in the practice management system and hands calls to staff when needed.

 An understanding of machine learning algorithms and techniques.

 Who We Serve: DCHC offers equity-focused programs and services for priority populations, including Indigenous peoples, Black communities, 2SLGBTQI+ community members, newcomers to Canada, seniors, and clients without a family doctor. This approach helps community members access both preventive care and care when they are ill.

Together, we place each client at the centre of care and respond to their needs through integrated clinical care, wellness supports, and health education.

 About HART Hub
 HART Hub provides low-barrier, client-centred services to individuals experiencing homelessness and housing instability. Our approach is grounded in dignity, respect, trauma-informed practice, choice, and practical support.
 As part of our expanding stabilization services, HART Hub will operate 13 stabilization units providing 24/7 accommodation and support for individuals who require a safe, stable environment while working toward longer-term housing and community stability.
 We are seeking compassionate, reliable and skilled Case Workers to join our 24/7 stabilization team.
 Position Overview 
 The Case Worker is a frontline member of the Stabilization Services team and plays a central role in supporting residents throughout their stay.
 Working as part of a 24/7 team, Case Workers provide a consistent and welcoming presence within the stabilization program. They develop trusting relationships with residents, support day-to-day needs, identify emerging concerns, assist with service connections and contribute to individualized housing and stabilization plans.
 This position is well suited to someone who understands that stability begins with relationship, safety, dignity and consistency .
 The Case Worker does not work in isolation. They collaborate closely with the HART Hub Case Management, Housing, Primary Care, Addictions, System Navigation and leadership teams to ensure residents receive coordinated support.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Resident Support & Engagement 
 ·        Build respectful, professional and trusting relationships with residents.

 ·        Promote resident choice, independence, dignity and self-determination.
 ·        Encourage participation in appropriate programming, appointments and community resources.
 ·        Support residents in maintaining connections with family, community and service providers where appropriate and desired.
 ·        Recognize changes in presentation, behaviour or circumstances and communicate concerns to the appropriate team member.
 Stabilization & Housing Support 
 ·        Work with residents to identify immediate priorities and goals.
 ·        Support residents in developing and following individualized stabilization plans.
 ·        Assist residents to identify barriers to housing and community stability.
 ·        Support residents with housing-related tasks and referrals in collaboration with the Housing and Case Management teams.
 ·        Assist residents in accessing identification, income supports, health services, appointments, transportation and other essential resources.
 ·        Encourage skills that support successful transition to permanent housing.
 ·        Participate in discharge and transition planning.
 24/7 Stabilization Operations 
 ·        Maintain a safe, welcoming and respectful environment within the stabilization program.
 ·        Complete scheduled wellness checks and resident contacts in accordance with HART Hub procedures.
 ·        Respond appropriately to resident concerns, incidents and urgent situations.
 ·        Follow established emergency, safety, incident reporting and escalation procedures.

 ·        Assist with maintaining clean, organized and welcoming common areas.
 ·        Support the consistent application of program policies and procedures.
 ·        Participate in shift handovers and ensure important information is communicated between shifts.
 ·        Work collaboratively with colleagues across all shifts to provide continuity of care.
 Documentation & Communication

 ·        Complete case notes, incident reports, shift documentation and other required records.
 ·        Document significant changes, concerns, interventions and follow-up requirements.
 ·        Maintain confidentiality and protect resident privacy.
 ·        Communicate effectively with colleagues and partner service providers within appropriate privacy and consent requirements.
 ·        Participate in team meetings, case conferences and other collaborative planning processes.
 Team Collaboration 
 ·        Work collaboratively with Case Managers, Housing Coordinators, System Navigators, Primary Care, Addictions staff, Program Coordinators and leadership.
 ·        Participate in multidisciplinary discussions regarding resident needs and service planning.
 ·        Provide relevant frontline observations to support coordinated case planning.
 ·        Contribute to a positive, respectful and supportive team culture.
 ·        Participate in training, supervision and professional development.
 What We Are Looking For

 ·        A strong commitment to working with individuals experiencing homelessness, housing instability and complex barriers.
 ·        Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
 ·        A calm, compassionate and non-judgmental approach.
 ·        Ability to establish appropriate professional boundaries while building meaningful relationships.
 ·        Strong observation, communication and documentation skills.
 ·        Ability to remain calm and effective during challenging or unpredictable situations.
 ·        Understanding of trauma-informed and person-centred approaches.
 ·        Ability to work independently while functioning effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team.
 ·        Strong problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills.
 ·        Respect for diversity, individual choice and lived experience.
 ·        Reliability and flexibility in a 24/7 service environment.
 Key Qualifications 
 ·        Post-secondary education in Social Services, Social Work, Human Services, Behavioural Sciences, Community Development or a related field is required.
 ·        Relevant education and/or equivalent experience will be considered.
 ·        1-2 year’s Experience working with individuals experiencing homelessness, housing instability, mental health concerns, substance use, poverty or other complex social barriers is an asset.

 ·        Valid driver’s licence and access to reliable transportation may be required depending on program responsibilities.

 Trauma-Informed Practice : Understands how trauma can affect behaviour, communication, relationships and engagement.

 The CRM Specialist - Strategy & Customer Journey is a CRM specialist with a strategic, customer-experience lens who helps Level's clients understand how their customers move through the lifecycle, where that experience breaks down, and what to do about it. This is not a pure strategy role, and it is not a pure build role: we are looking for someone who can map a customer journey with stakeholders in the morning and query the CRM to validate their hypothesis in the afternoon, without waiting on a data analyst or engineer.
 About Level
 Level Agency is an AI-powered performance marketing agency built for brands ready to shatter yesterday’s wins.
 We help complex, high-consideration brands outperform their last result using AI, data science, creativity, and relentless iteration.
 We specialize in markets where the stakes are high and the journeys are complex — education, B2B technology, financial services, healthcare, CPG, ecommerce, and more. Our work spans the full performance ecosystem: media planning & buying, performance creative, SEO & AI search, CRM & automation, and advanced analytics.
 In 2025, Level acquired BAM Strategy — expanding our capabilities into digital experience, CRM strategy, personalization, and loyalty. The result is a fully integrated growth engine that connects acquisition to retention, media to lifecycle, and performance to long-term customer value.
 Today, our 250-person team operates fully remote across the U.S. and Canada, supporting 150+ ambitious brands.
 Your Role (and Impact)
 Sitting within Level's Martech & Analytics team, this person helps run journey discovery and mapping, identifies friction points and missed opportunities across touchpoints, and turns those insights into prioritized recommendations. They are fluent enough in Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign, and Microsoft Dynamics 365 to explore customer data directly, size an opportunity, and build or adjust the journeys and segments that bring their recommendations to life. The ideal candidate is a curious, proactive specialist who connects the "why" of the customer experience to the "how" of the platform.
 Support and help facilitate customer journey discovery with clients and internal teams, including workshops and interviews to understand customer goals, behaviors, and pain points across the lifecycle (acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, win-back)
 Build current-state and future-state customer journey maps that connect customer needs, touchpoints, channels, data, and business objectives
 Identify friction points, drop-off moments, and missed opportunities in the customer journey, and translate them into prioritized, measurable recommendations with a clear business case
 Independently explore and query CRM data in Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign, and/or Microsoft Dynamics 365 (e.g., SQL query activities, data extensions, workflows, Advanced Find, FetchXML, views and reports) to validate hypotheses, size audiences, and diagnose performance issues without relying on a dedicated data expert
 Assess the health of client CRM data and data models, flagging gaps in data capture, quality, or structure that limit personalization or measurement, and recommending practical fixes
 Help define audience segmentation strategies and personalization frameworks grounded in customer data and lifecycle stage
 Translate journey strategy into implementation-ready requirements, and configure, build, or adjust journeys, segments, and campaigns in the CRM platform when needed
 Partner with other CRM specialists and developers on builds, reviewing logic, entry/exit criteria, and decisioning to ensure the build matches the intended experience
 Help define KPIs and measurement plans for journeys and programs, analyze performance, and design tests (A/B, holdout, multivariate) to prove and improve impact
 Present findings and recommendations to internal teams and client stakeholders, explaining the customer insight, the data behind it, and the technical approach in plain language
 Bring a proposed solution, not just the problem, when escalating issues that require architecture-level or cross-team decisions
 Document journey maps, data findings, and recommendations so the team has a clear and reusable record of decisions
 Skills & Qualifications
 Must-Haves: 
 Experience contributing to customer journey mapping or customer experience work, from discovery through recommendations
 Hands-on experience in at least one of Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign (Classic or Standard) / Adobe Journey Optimizer, or Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Customer Insights - Journeys or Marketing), with working familiarity in at least one other
 Ability to independently access, query, and interpret CRM data (e.g., SQL, data extensions, Adobe workflows and queries, Dynamics Advanced Find / FetchXML / views) to answer business questions without a dedicated analyst
 Strong lifecycle marketing understanding: you can explain why a journey is designed a certain way, spot when it isn't serving the customer or the business, and propose a better approach
 Ability to translate strategy into clear implementation requirements, and to build or adjust journeys and segments yourself when needed
 Comfort with data analysis and measurement, including defining KPIs, reading performance trends, and designing tests
 Good facilitation, storytelling, and presentation skills, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and push back on a brief that won't serve the customer
 Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining data and technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
 Preferred: 
 Hands-on experience across all three platforms: Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Journey Builder, Automation Studio, AMPscript, SQL), Adobe Campaign / Adobe Journey Optimizer / Adobe Experience Platform, and Microsoft Dynamics 365
 Experience with customer data platforms (CDPs) and unified customer profiles (e.g., Adobe Real-Time CDP, Salesforce Data Cloud, Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Data)
 Experience with journey mapping and collaboration tools (e.g., Miro, Figma/FigJam, Lucidchart, Smaply)
 Familiarity with BI and analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Google Analytics) to complement CRM analysis
 Background in service design, UX research, or voice-of-customer programs
 Working knowledge of email/SMS compliance regulations (CAN-SPAM, TCPA, CASL) and data privacy (GDPR, CCPA)
 Telecom or B2C subscription-industry CRM experience
 Agency-side or client-facing consulting experience
 Education & Experience
 Must-Haves: 
 Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Information Systems, Business, Computer Science, or a related field (or 4 additional years of equivalent professional experience)
 3 to 5 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or customer experience, including hands-on work in an enterprise CRM or marketing automation platform and exposure to journey strategy or customer experience projects
 Preferred: 
 Salesforce Marketing Cloud certification (e.g., Consultant, Email Specialist, or Developer)
 Adobe Certified Professional or Expert in Adobe Campaign or Adobe Journey Optimizer
 Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights (Journeys) Functional Consultant Associate, or equivalent
 Customer experience or journey mapping certification (e.g., CCXP)
 Agency experience supporting CRM programs for multiple clients simultaneously
 AI Expectations
 At Level, proficiency with AI tools is a core part of your role—not a nice-to-have. Your success in this position depends not only on your functional expertise, but also on your ability to actively integrate AI into how you work.
 You are expected to:
 Experiment continuously with AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney, Claude, Perplexity) to improve the speed, quality, and impact of your work (e.g., draft briefs, summarize research, analyze data trends, generate initial strategic frameworks, identify patterns in large datasets).
 Proactively document and share what you learn—your prompts, process improvements, and use cases—so others can benefit and we can grow together.
 Approach AI with an iterative mindset, refining how you apply it to your work over time. The first idea is rarely the best; testing, tweaking, and improving is part of the process.
 Lean into discomfort, especially when tools or workflows feel unfamiliar. Growth happens when you're stretching beyond what's comfortable or routine.
 AI is not a shortcut—it’s a skillset. You’re expected to use it as a force multiplier for creativity, strategy, and execution, not as a substitute for thoughtful work. As our tools evolve, your ability to adapt and lead through change will be a key part of your performance and growth at Level.
 Our Core Values
 No Ego, All In 
We don't do "that's not my job." We win together, step in where needed, and care more about the outcome than the org chart.
 Better Every Day 
We want the feedback, even when it stings. We test, learn, adapt, and keep raising the bar.
 Relentless for Results 
Activity is nothing without outcomes. We care about the work that moves the business forward.
 Driven by Truth 
We challenge assumptions, follow the data, and tell clients what they need to hear, not just what is easy to say.
 Perks & Benefits
 At Level, we support our people across the U.S. and Canada with benefits designed to promote flexibility, wellbeing, and long-term growth.
 Fully remote across the U.S. & Canada, plus monthly WFH stipend and Summer Fridays
 Generous time off, including unlimited PTO (U.S.), competitive vacation (Canada), and parental/family leave options
 Comprehensive health benefits, mental health support, and company-paid disability & life coverage
 Employer retirement contributions (401(k) in the U.S., RRSP match in Canada)
 Quarterly performance reviews and career advancement opportunities
 Remote First
 This role is open to U.S. and Canada residents and is fully remote. Occasional travel may be required for company events and team working sessions. We are unable to sponsor visas at this time.
 Level Is Built on Inclusion
 We celebrate what makes you, you. Level Agency provides reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities during the recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please let us know during your application or interview process.
 Ready to Apply?
 Click below to submit your resume. You'll also answer a few thoughtful questions, so take your time.
 We care more about what you can do than whether your career path was perfectly linear.
 Let's build something together. 
 AI HIRING DISCLAIMER 
 We use AI-assisted tools to support parts of our hiring process, including resume screening and interview note-taking or summarization. These tools support, but do not replace, human judgment. All hiring decisions are made by Level's hiring team.

 Le poste de spécialiste CRM - Stratégie et parcours client s'adresse à une personne spécialiste du CRM, dotée d'un regard stratégique centré sur l'expérience client, qui aide les clients de Level à comprendre comment leurs clients évoluent tout au long du cycle de vie, à quels endroits cette expérience se dégrade, et quoi faire pour y remédier. Ce n'est ni un rôle purement stratégique, ni un rôle exclusivement axé sur la mise en œuvre technique : nous cherchons une personne capable de cartographier un parcours client avec les parties prenantes le matin, puis d'interroger le CRM l'après-midi pour valider son hypothèse, sans attendre l'intervention d'un analyste de données ou d'un ingénieur.
 À propos de Level
 Level Agency est une agence de marketing de performance propulsée par l’IA, conçue pour les marques prêtes à faire voler en éclats les succès d’hier.
 Nous aidons des marques complexes, dont le cycle de décision est long, à surpasser leur dernier résultat grâce à l’IA, à la science des données, à la créativité et à une itération acharnée.
 Nous sommes spécialisés dans les marchés où les enjeux sont élevés et où les parcours sont complexes : éducation, technologies B2B, services financiers, santé, produits de grande consommation (PGC), commerce électronique, et plus encore. Notre travail couvre tout l’écosystème de la performance : planification et achat média, créatifs de performance, SEO et recherche IA, CRM et automatisation, et analytique avancée.
 En 2025, Level a acquis BAM Strategy, élargissant ses capacités à l’expérience numérique, à la stratégie CRM, à la personnalisation et à la fidélisation. Le résultat : un moteur de croissance entièrement intégré, qui relie l’acquisition à la rétention, les médias au cycle de vie, et la performance à la valeur client à long terme.
 Aujourd’hui, notre équipe de 250 personnes travaille entièrement à distance partout aux États-Unis et au Canada, au service de plus de 150 marques ambitieuses.
 Votre rôle (et votre impact)
 Au sein de l'équipe Martech et Analytics de Level, cette personne contribue à mener la découverte et la cartographie des parcours, repère les points de friction et les occasions manquées à travers les points de contact, et transforme ces constats en recommandations priorisées. Elle maîtrise suffisamment Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign et Microsoft Dynamics 365 pour explorer directement les données clients, évaluer l'ampleur d'une occasion, et créer ou ajuster les parcours et les segments qui concrétisent ses recommandations. La personne candidate idéale est une personne spécialiste curieuse et proactive, qui relie le « pourquoi » de l'expérience client au « comment » de la plateforme.
 Soutenir et contribuer à animer la découverte des parcours client auprès des clients et des équipes internes, notamment au moyen d'ateliers et d'entrevues, afin de comprendre les objectifs, les comportements et les irritants des clients tout au long du cycle de vie (acquisition, intégration, engagement, fidélisation, reconquête)
 Élaborer des cartes de parcours client de l'état actuel et de l'état futur qui relient les besoins des clients, les points de contact, les canaux, les données et les objectifs d'affaires
 Repérer les points de friction, les moments d'abandon et les occasions manquées dans le parcours client, et les traduire en recommandations priorisées et mesurables, appuyées par un argumentaire d'affaires clair
 Explorer et interroger de façon autonome les données CRM dans Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign et/ou Microsoft Dynamics 365 (p. ex. activités de requête SQL, data extensions, workflows, Advanced Find, FetchXML, vues et rapports) afin de valider des hypothèses, de dimensionner des audiences et de diagnostiquer des problèmes de performance sans dépendre d'une personne experte des données dédiée
 Évaluer la santé des données et des modèles de données CRM des clients, en signalant les lacunes de saisie, de qualité ou de structure des données qui limitent la personnalisation ou la mesure, et en recommandant des correctifs pratiques
 Contribuer à définir des stratégies de segmentation d'audience et des cadres de personnalisation fondés sur les données clients et sur l'étape du cycle de vie
 Traduire la stratégie de parcours en exigences prêtes pour la mise en œuvre, et configurer, créer ou ajuster des parcours, des segments et des campagnes dans la plateforme CRM au besoin
 Collaborer avec les autres spécialistes CRM et avec l'équipe de développement à la réalisation des builds, en révisant la logique, les critères d'entrée et de sortie et la logique décisionnelle afin de s'assurer que la réalisation correspond à l'expérience visée
 Contribuer à définir les KPI et les plans de mesure des parcours et des programmes, analyser la performance et concevoir des tests (A/B, groupe témoin, multivariés) afin de démontrer et d'améliorer l'impact
 Présenter les constats et les recommandations aux équipes internes et aux parties prenantes des clients, en expliquant l'éclairage client, les données qui le soutiennent et l'approche technique en langage simple
 Proposer une solution, et pas seulement le problème, au moment d'escalader des enjeux qui exigent des décisions d'architecture ou des décisions entre plusieurs équipes
 Documenter les cartes de parcours, les constats sur les données et les recommandations afin que l'équipe dispose d'un registre clair et réutilisable des décisions
 Compétences et qualifications
 Incontournables : 
 Expérience de contribution à des travaux de cartographie du parcours client ou d'expérience client, de la découverte jusqu'aux recommandations
 Expérience pratique dans au moins l'une des plateformes suivantes : Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign (Classic ou Standard) / Adobe Journey Optimizer, ou Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Customer Insights - Journeys ou Marketing), avec une connaissance fonctionnelle d'au moins une autre
 Capacité à accéder, à interroger et à interpréter de façon autonome les données CRM (p. ex. SQL, data extensions, workflows et requêtes Adobe, Advanced Find / FetchXML / vues Dynamics) pour répondre à des questions d'affaires sans analyste dédié
 Solide compréhension du marketing du cycle de vie : vous savez expliquer pourquoi un parcours est conçu d'une certaine façon, déceler quand il ne sert pas le client ou l'entreprise, et proposer une meilleure approche
 Capacité à traduire une stratégie en exigences de mise en œuvre claires, et à créer ou à ajuster vous-même des parcours et des segments au besoin
 Aisance en analyse de données et en mesure, y compris la définition des KPI, la lecture des tendances de performance et la conception de tests
 Bonnes habiletés d'animation, de narration (storytelling) et de présentation, et l'assurance nécessaire pour remettre en question des hypothèses et s'opposer à un brief qui ne servira pas le client
 Communication écrite et verbale claire, y compris la capacité d'expliquer des concepts liés aux données et à la technique à des parties prenantes non techniques
 Atouts : 
 Expérience pratique des trois plateformes : Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Journey Builder, Automation Studio, AMPscript, SQL), Adobe Campaign / Adobe Journey Optimizer / Adobe Experience Platform, et Microsoft Dynamics 365
 Expérience avec les plateformes de données clients (CDP) et les profils clients unifiés (p. ex. Adobe Real-Time CDP, Salesforce Data Cloud, Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Data)
 Expérience avec des outils de cartographie de parcours et de collaboration (p. ex. Miro, Figma/FigJam, Lucidchart, Smaply)
 Connaissance des outils de BI et d'analytique (p. ex. Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Google Analytics) en complément de l'analyse CRM
 Expérience en design de services, en recherche UX ou dans des programmes de voix du client
 Connaissance pratique de la réglementation sur la conformité des courriels et des messages texte (SMS) (CAN-SPAM, TCPA, LCAP/CASL) et de la protection des renseignements personnels (RGPD, CCPA)
 Expérience CRM dans le secteur des télécommunications ou des abonnements B2C
 Expérience côté agence ou en consultation en contact direct avec les clients
 Formation et expérience
 Incontournables : 
 Baccalauréat en marketing, en systèmes d'information, en administration des affaires, en informatique ou dans un domaine connexe (ou 4 années supplémentaires d'expérience professionnelle équivalente)
 De 3 à 5 années d'expérience en CRM, en marketing du cycle de vie ou en expérience client, incluant un travail pratique dans une plateforme d'entreprise de CRM ou d'automatisation du marketing et une exposition à des projets de stratégie de parcours ou d'expérience client
 Atouts : 
 Certification Salesforce Marketing Cloud (p. ex. Consultant, Email Specialist ou Developer)
 Adobe Certified Professional ou Expert en Adobe Campaign ou en Adobe Journey Optimizer
 Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights (Journeys) Functional Consultant Associate, ou l'équivalent
 Certification en expérience client ou en cartographie de parcours (p. ex. CCXP)
 Expérience en agence à soutenir des programmes CRM pour plusieurs clients 
 Attentes en matière d’IA
 Chez Level, la maîtrise des outils d’IA fait partie intégrante de votre rôle, et n’est pas un simple atout. Votre réussite dans ce poste repose non seulement sur votre expertise fonctionnelle, mais aussi sur votre capacité à intégrer activement l’IA à votre façon de travailler.
 On s’attend à ce que vous :
 Expérimentiez continuellement avec des outils d’IA (p. ex. ChatGPT, Midjourney, Claude, Perplexity) pour améliorer la rapidité, la qualité et l’impact de votre travail (p. ex. rédiger des mandats, résumer des recherches, analyser des tendances dans les données, générer des cadres stratégiques initiaux, repérer des tendances dans de grands ensembles de données)
 Documentiez et partagiez de façon proactive ce que vous apprenez (vos requêtes, vos améliorations de processus et vos cas d’usage), afin que les autres en profitent et que nous progressions ensemble
 Abordiez l’IA avec un état d’esprit itératif, en affinant votre façon de l’utiliser au fil du temps. La première idée est rarement la meilleure : tester, ajuster et améliorer fait partie du processus
 Acceptiez l’inconfort, surtout lorsque les outils ou les flux de travail vous sont peu familiers. La croissance survient lorsqu’on dépasse ce qui est confortable ou routinier
 L’IA n’est pas un raccourci, c’est une compétence. On s’attend à ce que vous l’utilisiez comme multiplicateur de force pour la créativité, la stratégie et l’exécution, et non comme substitut à un travail réfléchi. À mesure que nos outils évoluent, votre capacité à vous adapter et à mener le changement sera un élément clé de votre performance et de votre croissance chez Level.
 Nos valeurs fondamentales
 Pas d’ego, tous engagés 
Chez nous, pas de « ce n’est pas mon travail ». Nous gagnons ensemble, nous intervenons là où c’est nécessaire et nous nous soucions davantage du résultat que de l’organigramme.
 Meilleurs chaque jour 
Nous voulons la rétroaction, même quand elle pique. Nous testons, apprenons, nous adaptons et continuons de relever la barre.
 Acharnés pour les résultats 
L’activité ne vaut rien sans résultats. Ce qui compte, c’est le travail qui fait avancer l’entreprise.
 Guidés par la vérité 
Nous remettons les hypothèses en question, nous suivons les données et nous disons aux clients ce qu’ils ont besoin d’entendre, pas seulement ce qui est facile à dire.
 Avantages sociaux
 Chez Level, nous soutenons nos employés partout aux États-Unis et au Canada grâce à des avantages conçus pour favoriser la flexibilité, le bien-être et la croissance à long terme.
 Télétravail complet partout aux États-Unis et au Canada, avec allocation mensuelle de télétravail et vendredis d’été

 Remote First : le télétravail d’abord
 Ce poste est ouvert aux résidents des États-Unis et du Canada et se fait entièrement en télétravail. Des déplacements occasionnels peuvent être requis pour des événements de l’entreprise et des séances de travail d’équipe. Nous ne sommes pas en mesure de parrainer des visas pour le moment.
 Level mise sur l’inclusion
 Nous célébrons ce qui fait de vous qui vous êtes. Level Agency offre des mesures d’adaptation raisonnables aux personnes candidates en situation de handicap pendant le processus de recrutement. Si vous avez besoin de mesures d’adaptation, faites-le-nous savoir lors de votre candidature ou de votre entrevue.
 Prêt(e) à postuler?
 Cliquez ci-dessous pour soumettre votre CV. Vous répondrez aussi à quelques questions réfléchies, alors prenez votre temps.
 Nous accordons plus d’importance à ce que vous savez faire qu’à un parcours professionnel parfaitement linéaire.
 Bâtissons quelque chose ensemble. 
 Avis sur l’utilisation de l’IA dans l’embauche 
 Nous utilisons des outils assistés par l’IA pour appuyer certaines étapes de notre processus d’embauche, notamment le tri des CV et la prise de notes ou la synthèse des entrevues. Ces outils appuient le jugement humain, sans le remplacer. Toutes les décisions d’embauche sont prises par l’équipe d’embauche de Level.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!


Role Overview:
At Cohere, we're pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can achieve for production environments, and we're seeking a senior engineer who understands the practical challenges of making AI systems work at scale. This role demands deep technical expertise in production environments and the ability to bridge research concepts with real-world implementations.

This position is hands-on and engineering-driven. You'll focus on production systems, experiment with frontier models, and collaborate with talented engineers to build scalable, production ready solutions. We strive for excellence in both engineering and science by meticulously designing experiments and design docs. We blend engineering and research seamlessly. Everyone contributes to both, depending on organizational needs. We provide access to world class compute resources, data, and talent to ensure you can do your best work. This role is perfect for you if you:

 - Have a deep passion for quality work.

 - Enjoy tuning and optimising large LLM models.

 - Comfortable working with people with different levels of software engineering skills, from beginner to more advanced.

 - Comfortable diving into complex ML codebases to identify and resolve issues, ensuring the smooth operation of our systems.

 - Thrive in a fast-paced, technically challenging environment, where you can contribute your innovative ideas and solutions.





Key responsibilities:

 - Design and write high-performing and scalable software for training models.

 - Develop new tools to support and accelerate research and LLM training.

 - Coordinate with other engineering teams (Infrastructure, Efficiency, Serving) and the scientific teams (Agent, Multimodal, Multilingual, etc.).

 - Research, implement, and experiment with ideas on our cluster and data infrastructure.

 - Collaborate, Collaborate, and Collaborate with other scientists, engineers, and teams!


Qualifications:

 - Extremely strong software engineering skills.

 - Value test-driven development methods, clean code, and strive to reduce technical debts at all levels.

 - Proficiency in Python and related ML frameworks such as JAX, Pytorch and/or XLA/MLIR.

 - Experience using and debugging large-scale distributed training strategies (memory/speed profiling).

 - Experience with distributed training infrastructures (Kubernetes) and associated frameworks (Ray).

 - Experience in ML and LLM academic research.





Working Location:
This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of locations, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role.




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 Strong problem-solving abilities and comfort working through ambiguity.

 Edit work across a wide range of formats and durations, from short-form and social content through :06, :15, :30 and longer-form storytelling.

 Bring a strong editorial perspective to the work, helping teams find the strongest story, performance, pacing, structure and creative execution rather than simply executing a brief. 
 Create and implement motion graphics as part of day-to-day editorial, including supers, typography, transitions, end cards, graphic treatments and other motion elements required to bring an edit to completion.

 Prepare and adapt work across broadcast, social and digital specifications, including short-form cutdowns and platform-specific versioning.

 Perform editorial QC and prepare final files for review, approval and delivery, ensuring accuracy across picture, audio, graphics, supers, aspect ratios, versioning and technical specifications. 
 Work confidently within established post workflows while helping us continue to develop and strengthen our growing in-house editorial capability. 
 Work on-site from our Liberty Village office during designated in-office days, currently Tuesday and Thursday. 
 Work effectively across both in-person and remote editorial workflows, collaborating with teams and stakeholders across Toronto and Chicago. 
 Experience with collaborative review platforms such as Frame.io and remote post-production workflows. 
 Share knowledge, best practices and technical expertise with the broader team, contributing to the continued development of our editorial standards and capabilities. 
 Have experience with Extreme Reach submission or uploading for broadcast deliverables. 
 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR 
 7+ years of professional editorial experience within an advertising agency, in-house agency, production company or post-production environment, with agency and/or in-house experience strongly preferred. 
 A strong portfolio or reel demonstrating editorial craft, creative thinking and a high level of polish across finished work. 
 Demonstrated experience working on food, beverage and/or food-adjacent advertising and content . 
 Extensive experience with professional NLE systems and contemporary post-production workflows. 
 Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and comfort working within the broader Adobe Creative Suite . 
 Strong proficiency in After Effects , with the ability to independently design, build and implement motion graphics required for everyday advertising and content work. 
 Working knowledge of Photoshop and an understanding of how design assets move between creative and editorial workflows. 
 Experience with DaVinci Resolve or Baselight is an asset. 
 Comfort performing light colour correction and grading, with an understanding of when work should transition to a dedicated colourist or finishing partner.

 Strong understanding of media management, codecs, formats, versioning, conforming and preparing projects for downstream colour, VFX, audio and online finishing. 
 Experience working directly with Creative, Production and Account teams as well as clients or brand stakeholders. 
 Strong creative instincts and an ability to interpret feedback, contribute ideas and recommend editorial solutions. 
 Comfortable working independently while managing competing priorities, tight timelines and multiple stakeholders. 
 Highly organized, detail-oriented, collaborative and calm within a fast-moving production environment. 
 Demonstrated ability to take editorial ownership of a project from initial assembly through approval, proactively identifying creative and technical needs rather than waiting for direction at each stage.

 You become a trusted creative and production partner across the agency, someone Producers, Creatives and brand teams want in the room early and rely on when the work gets complicated. 
 You bring both craft and practicality to post-production: strong editorial instincts, motion capabilities, excellent technical knowledge and an understanding of what it takes to move modern advertising work efficiently from footage through finished creative.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who is excited to connect a whole new part of the ecosystem into Jobber, solving problems for service providers at every step of their workflow.  Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.
 We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.
 About the role 
 Search is how retailers do their jobs on Faire. Wholesale queries and retailer expectations look different from consumer e-commerce and the right product depends on the store's category, price point, and aesthetic. When we get it wrong, it costs real money.
 The Search algorithms team owns everything between the click on the search bar and the final ranker: typeahead and empty-state suggestions, query understanding, retrieval across five-plus independent sources, relevance modeling, and result-page surfaces like carousels and refinements. Within our scope, scientists own components outright: when you own query understanding here, you own the models, the roadmap, and the metrics.
 You'll work across the full modern search stack: transformer-based embedding retrieval serving live traffic, LLMs powering query understanding and query rewriting, fine-tuned vision-language models scoring relevance, and graph-based retrieval — with generative retrieval and semantic IDs on the horizon.
 What you'll do 
 Contribute to the next-generation Search engine, integrating LLMs, query understanding, dense vector retrieval, deep personalization embeddings, multi-stage ranking, and reinforcement learning to serve personalized product feeds with <100ms latency.
 Own one or more search components end to end: problem framing, modeling, production code, experiment design, and the call on what to build next.
 Ship to live traffic and let A/B tests, not opinions, settle what works.
 Raise the team's bar through design reviews, pairing, and honest post-mortems
 You're a great fit if you have 
 3+ years building production ML systems, with meaningful time in search, recommendations, or another retrieval-and-relevance domain.
 Shipped models that served real traffic, and owned the experiments that proved (or disproved) their value.
 Depth somewhere in the modern retrieval stack — dual encoders and ANN serving, LLM-based query understanding, learning-to-rank fundamentals — and the ability to pick up the rest. 
 Strong Python and the engineering chops to take your own models to production.
 Clear communication with scientists, engineers, and PMs: you make a crisp case for your ideas and update quickly when someone has a better one.
 Excellent product judgment to connect customer and business context to technical decisions

 Marketplace or e-commerce experience

 MS or PhD in CS, Statistics, or a related field.

About Owner

Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants.

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.



Product philosophy

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.



Our vision



We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.



But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.



Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.



In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.



Our traction



Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com http://Owner.com website.



More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees.



Our team



Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.



We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth.



Where we work



Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location!





Role Overview

Owner's promise to a restaurant isn't software, it's revenue. When a guest lands on a restaurant's site, we want them to find what they're craving, trust what they see, and check out without friction, whether or not the owner ever touches a setting.

As we scale, we're expanding our product engineering leadership to ship faster, raise the bar on the guest ordering experience, and build the systems that make it work across thousands of restaurants. As the Engineering Manager for OLO, you'll lead a team of full-stack engineers building the guest web ordering experience, from menu, cart and checkout to promotions, photos, and the menu quality systems that make about 10,000 merchant-written menus convert like they were designed by a pro. Next, we're taking OLO to enterprise and multi-location brands, and pushing guest conversion toward 10% through disciplined experimentation. This role is equal parts product intuition and technical execution. You'll be trusted to make hard prioritization calls, ship experiments that move revenue, and grow a team that embodies engineering excellence.

We move with urgency, bias toward simplicity, and expect our leaders to be hands-on when needed. If you're energized by ownership, measurable impact, and solving real problems for small business owners, we'd love to hear from you.

Why we’re looking for you

Owner's promise to a restaurant isn't software — it's revenue. OLO is where that promise gets converted: the guest web ordering experience (menu, cart, checkout, promotions) plus the automated systems that find and fix menu quality problems across roughly 10,000 menus written by merchants we don't control.

We treat conversion as an automated system, not a design review. We build rubrics, detection, and remediation, then prove every change with an experiment. Next, we're taking OLO upmarket to enterprise and multi-location brands and pushing conversion toward 10%.

We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the team through that, keep it healthy, and hold a high bar on what we ship and what we cut.

This role is 100% remote and can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada.

Our Stack

 - Web / Growth: React, Next.js, TypeScript — guest web ordering, menu quality, experimentation platform

 - Backend & Services: Node.js, MongoDB → PostgreSQL (migration in flight), Temporal, Datadog

 - Language: TypeScript everywhere

The Impact You'll Have

 - Build the experimentation engine that pushes guest conversion toward 10%, across checkout, fulfillment, merchandising, and promotions

 - Take OLO to enterprise and multi-location brands, with the reliability and menu complexity they need

 - Get >90% of menus, including POS-integrated ones, to our menu quality bar, and build the system that keeps live menus optimized as they change

 - Scale photo coverage using guest sourcing, auto-replating, licensed catalogs, and generated combo images, each tied to measured GPV lift

 - Rebuild promotions from the ground up: redemption UX, badges, auto-apply, and merchandising

 - Cut fulfillment selection errors and finish the Postgres migration

What we’re looking for

 - 3+ years of engineering management, leading teams of 6–10+ engineers on customer-facing product

 - Track record of running growth or conversion programs: metrics, A/B testing at scale, funnel analysis

 - Experience scaling a product for enterprise or multi-location customers

 - Strong prioritization: you can take a roadmap bigger than your team and make hard, clear calls

 - Technical credibility in full-stack web (React/TypeScript, Node.js) and data-heavy systems

 - Cares about team health and has led people through heavy or repetitive workloads

 - Excellent cross-functional partner to PM, design, and adjacent teams

Compensation and benefits

 - The estimated base salary range for this role is $250K-$270K, depending on experience and location. The offer also includes a a generous pre-IPO equity package.

 - Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, remote-first workplace, unlimited PTO - plus extra fun perks!





Notice - Employment Scams

Communication from our team regarding job opportunities will only be made by an Owner team member with an @owner.com email address.



We do not conduct interviews over email or chat platforms, and we will never ask you to provide personal or financial information such as your mailing address, social security number, credit card numbers or banking information. If you believe you are being contacted by a scammer, please mark the communication as "phishing" or “spam” and do not respond.

 À propos de Mila 
 Mila est un institut de recherche basé à Montréal qui rassemble la plus grande communauté académique au monde spécialisée en apprentissage profond. Fondé par le professeur Yoshua Bengio, l’institut est reconnu mondialement pour son expertise et ses innovations en modélisation du langage, en traduction automatique, en reconnaissance d’objets et en modèles génératifs. La mission de Mila est d'être un pôle mondial d'avancées scientifiques qui inspire l'innovation et le développement de l'IA au bénéfice de tous.
 Le défi 
 Mila est à un point d’inflexion : nous tirons parti de notre leadership scientifique pour ancrer et façonner un écosystème mondial de l’IA. Cette évolution nécessite une réflexion stratégique transversale approfondie pour maximiser notre impact sociétal, économique et scientifique, tout en soutenant le déploiement de projets majeurs.
 La personne titulaire du poste sera un·e architecte clé de cette vision. Relevant du Chef de la Transformation Stratégique, vous mènerez des analyses de fond et traduirez des ambitions complexes en initiatives stratégiques concrètes. En synergie avec les capacités de modélisation de l'équipe, vous fournirez des recommandations éclairées et guiderez la direction de Mila dans ses décisions les plus structurantes.
 Principales responsabilités 
 1. Évolution stratégique et soutien à la décision
 Soutenir la création et le déploiement d'initiatives stratégiques en formulant des hypothèses, en menant des recherches approfondies, en effectuant des analyses fondées sur des données et en collaborant étroitement avec les différentes parties prenantes, aux profils et expertises variées.
 Fournir les éléments d'analyse, les diagnostics et les cadres méthodologiques nécessaires pour guider la prise de décision de la haute direction.
 Superviser le processus de mise à jour des plans d'action annuels, en veillant à ce qu'ils soient parfaitement alignés sur les priorités stratégiques de Mila à travers l'ensemble des équipes.
 Assurer le suivi de l’exécution du plan, en veillant à conserver un alignement avec les parties prenantes impliquées.
 Collaborer avec les équipes, possédant des compétences et expertises pointues, dans la réalisation de projets stratégiques porteurs.
 Coordonner et animer des sessions stratégiques destinées aux différentes parties prenantes internes et externes.
 2. Analyse qualitative et quantitative
 Effectuer des analyses complètes sur les tendances de l'IA, les écosystèmes technologiques mondiaux, l'impact de Mila et les opportunités émergentes, en s'appuyant sur des données qualitatives et quantitatives provenant de diverses sources.
 Assurer une veille stratégique sur le développement du secteur et les avancées dans d'autres écosystèmes d’innovation afin d’en faire ressortir des idées porteuses et d'identifier des opportunités de croissance.

 Contribuer à l'élaboration et à la mise en œuvre d'améliorations des processus et de changements opérationnels pour garantir l'atteinte de nos objectifs stratégiques globaux.
 4. Collaboration et liaison avec les parties prenantes
 Agir en tant que rassembleur·se stratégique en coordonnant la collaboration d'équipes interfonctionnelles pour assurer l'alignement et le lancement réussi des initiatives au sein de l'organisation.
 Collaborer de près avec les parties prenantes internes (professeur·es, étudiant·es, scientifiques de l'IA, partenaires industriels) pour recueillir des données, identifier les opportunités inexploitées, tester des nouvelles idées et conserver un alignement stratégique en tout temps.

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era.  The Okta Secures AI Team 
 The Okta Secures AI Team is building the future of digital identity management. The way companies are using agents and allowing them access is undergoing a fundamental shift, enabling teams to move fast while staying secure. 
 Our North Star is clear: To get AI right, you have to get identity right. We are not just managing identities; we are building the industry's first Identity Security Fabric for the agentic era. As organizations rapidly deploy AI, these non-human entities are acting with access to critical tools, often bypassing traditional perimeters and creating a 'Shadow AI' crisis. Our mission is to move identity from a reactive gatekeeper to a unified control plane, transforming AI risk into business ROI.
 We are tackling this by implementing a comprehensive four-pillar maturity model: Discover, Onboard, Protect, and Govern. We are driving innovation by defining the standards for Agent Identity—including pioneer work with the AI Agent Tool Registry and support for protocols like MCP and IPSIE. You will be helping us build the infrastructure that allows enterprises to scale AI safely, ensuring every access decision—whether made by a human or an automated agent—is authenticated, authorized, and audited at scale.

 You will lead the technical implementation of our four-pillar maturity model—Discover, Onboard, Protect, and Govern—to provide enterprise-grade visibility and governance for both human and non-human identities.  This role requires deep expertise in distributed systems and a commitment to AI-native engineering as our standard. You will rethink backend design, validation, and delivery through AI-augmented workflows, ensuring our platform provides secure, interoperable, and scalable access—enforcing the principle of least privilege for every agent action.

ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT PRODUCTION ENGINEERING

Production Engineering is Ramp's infrastructure ownership layer. We exist to make Ramp faster, more reliable, and more scalable — and we do that by being embedded in the problems, not adjacent to them.

A few things that define how we operate:

 - One team, one company, one objective. There is no "infra team" and "product team" — there is Ramp. We share the company's goals as our own. When a product team struggles with reliability or scalability, that is our struggle.

 - If reliability or scalability is at risk, we own it. We don't wait to be invited, and we don't ask whose code it is. If a system is slow, if it breaks, if it won't scale — that's ours to lead, regardless of where it lives in the stack.

 - We go first, and we go fast. When the path isn't obvious, we don't wait for someone else to find it. We move with urgency, propose the solution, align the stakeholders, and stay in until it's done — not until our ticket is closed.

 - We lead the way. We find the next problem before it finds us. And when we solve it, we don't just fix it for ourselves — the patterns and standards we establish become the foundation the rest of Ramp builds on. That's not a side effect of the job; it's the job.

 - We stay calibrated. Speed means nothing if we're moving in the wrong direction. We regularly stop and ask honestly whether what we're working on is still the highest-leverage thing we could be doing — the discipline that makes sure our effort compounds toward what actually matters.

You cannot build the future of finance on shaky infrastructure.




OUR TEAMS

Production Engineering is organized into teams — but we think about teams differently. Teams are mutable. We build them around what needs to be done, not around what we need to do given the teams we already have. The structure below reflects our current priorities; it will evolve as Ramp does.

Right now, we operate across four areas:

 - Compute — the foundation everything runs on: container orchestration, networking, load balancing, edge infrastructure, and the deployment systems that get code from engineers' laptops to production reliably and at scale

 - Storage — databases, caching, object storage, and the data infrastructure that underpins everything

 - Workflows & Messaging — the systems that power Ramp's financial workflows and event-driven architecture

 - Internal Infrastructure — the platform that makes every builder at Ramp faster and more autonomous: observability, cost attribution, and CI/CD systems that give teams visibility into what they build and what it costs




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Production Engineers at Ramp are full software engineers who happen to specialize in infrastructure. You write production code, you own systems end-to-end, and you drive technical outcomes across the organization — not just within your team.

Day to day, you will:

 - Build and operate critical infrastructure across Ramp's compute, storage, messaging, and observability stack — owning the systems that handle real financial transactions at scale.

 - Drive architectural change — not just flag problems. When you surface a reliability or scalability issue, you own the path forward: you propose the solution, find the owners across engineering, and stay in until it's resolved.

 - Partner with product teams at the design phase — reviewing architectures, embedding golden paths, and making it easy to build correctly the first time.

 - Build Ramp's next level of scale — you'll be a hands-on contributor to the most consequential infrastructure shift happening right now: our move to a cellular architecture, enabling Ramp to scale, reach international markets, operate in highly regulated and constrained environments (e.g. FedRAMP), and deliver on enterprise-grade SLAs.

 - Enable AI-native engineering — as Ramp builds increasingly AI-powered products, PE is the team that makes sure the platform can support them. You'll proactively partner with product teams on AI infrastructure patterns, define the golden paths that turn one-off solutions into reusable foundations, and stay ahead of emerging challenges before they become blockers.

 - Build developer tooling and self-service infrastructure — so that other teams can answer their own questions (cost, performance, reliability) without involving PE.

 - Participate in on-call rotation — and more importantly, use every incident as a signal to eliminate the root cause, not just resolve the symptom.

 - Lead across the company — PE doesn't just review designs or show up when called. We proactively initiate cross-team architectural reviews, and we take full ownership of company-wide reliability and scalability initiatives: identifying the problem, proposing the solution, aligning the stakeholders, and staying in until it's done.




WHAT WE LOOK FOR

We don't hire for a checklist. We hire for the instincts that make someone exceptional on this team.

The mindset we're looking for:

 - You can't walk past something broken without wanting to fix it — and you don't stop at the workaround. You find the root cause and eliminate the class of problem.

 - You think in systems, not tasks. You understand that "fixing the bug" is step one; making it so the bug can't happen again is the job.

 - You move with urgency but without chaos. You know when to go fast and when to slow down and do it right.

 - You treat product teams as your users. You build for them, communicate with them proactively, and measure success by how much faster they can ship. But you're also an owner — when something is broken or blocking, you don't wait to be asked. We win when our customers win.

 - You leave things better than you found them. Every system you touch, every process you encounter — you move it forward. Not always dramatically, but always directionally. You picked it up in a certain state; you leave it in a better one.

 - You are equally comfortable reading a database query plan, reviewing a system design doc, writing a Terraform module, and jumping into an incident at 2am.

Experience profile:

 - 2+ years of software engineering experience shipping high-quality architectures for critical systems 

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals — you write clean, well-tested, production-ready code

 - Hands-on experience with distributed systems at production scale

 - Experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS preferred)

 - Familiarity with observability practices (SLOs, error budgets, alerting, dashboards)

 - Track record of leading technical projects end-to-end, including cross-team coordination

 - Comfortable using AI tooling and coding agents as part of your everyday engineering workflow — we expect our engineers to leverage these tools to move faster and think bigger

Bonus (not required):

 - Experience with cellular or multi-tenant architecture patterns

 - Prior work on workflow orchestration systems (Temporal)

 - Contributions to developer experience or internal platform tooling

 - Experience in fintech, payments, or regulated industries (FedRAMP, SOC 2)




BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

 • Own and maintain the Canada FC Operations QA Framework, develop and maintain QA procedures, review templates, sampling methodologies and evaluation criteria to reflect changes in regulations, policies, processes, systems and operational risks.

 • Support calibration activities to promote consistent interpretation of procedures, quality standards and adjudication expectations.

 Data Migration: Lead extraction, profiling, cleansing, normalization, match/merge and reconciliation through parallel run and cutover.

 Demonstrated experience migrating data from legacy/mainframe or packaged systems (extraction, cleansing, normalization, reconciliation, dual-run/cutover).
